    result = []

        op_type, *value = op.split()
        if op_type == 'insert':
            x = int(value[0])
            heapq.heappush(heap, x)
            result.append(op)

            if not heap:
                result.append('insert 0')  # Insert a dummy value to maintain consistency
                heapq.heappush(heap, 0)
            heapq.heappop(heap)
            result.append(op)
